content.title: Viktor Stoneheart
about: Viktor Stoneheart is a short first-person puzzle experience where you enter a client's dream to hunt and destroy nightmare fragments.
The playable space mirrors the client’s house, but shifted into a parallel “Dream World” with altered rules and atmosphere.
Created by SouthWest Studio during the CITM Game Jam (1 week).
features: First-person exploration with interactable objects and light puzzle solving
Atmospheric horror tone with a dream/parallel-world setting
Objective-driven progression: locate and destroy nightmare fragments
Compact scope and pacing designed for a jam build
learnings: Rapid iteration and scope control under a 1-week deadline
Designing readable objectives and progression for short experiences
Team coordination between code, art, and level design
